import json,sys,statistics,math,collections
from pathlib import Path
for root in map(Path,sys.argv[1:]):
 path=root/'rows.json'
 if not path.exists(): path=root/'rows.partial.json'
 rows=json.loads(path.read_text())
 print(root.name, len(rows), 'rows')
 groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
 for r in rows: groups[(r['scenario'],r.get('variant',r['manager']))].append(r)
 for key,g in groups.items():
  vals=sorted(r['wall_ms'] for r in g);rss=[r['max_rss_bytes']/1048576 for r in g if r.get('max_rss_bytes')]
  print(key, 'n',len(g),'median',statistics.median(vals),'p95',vals[math.ceil(.95*len(vals))-1],'range',[min(vals),max(vals)],'RSSmedian',round(statistics.median(rss),1) if rss else None)

from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,json,shutil,time,statistics,hashlib
root=Path('<scratch>');repo=Path('<repo>')
assert shutil.disk_usage(root).free>=10*1024**3
source=root/'lock-snapshot-probe.rs';binary=root/'lock-snapshot-probe';deps=Path('/tmp/lpm-cache-release-target-1940/release/deps');rlib=next(deps.glob('liblpm_lockfile-*.rlib'))
cmd=['rustc','+1.94.0','--edition=2024','-C','opt-level=3','-D','warnings','-L',f'dependency={deps}','--extern',f'lpm_lockfile={rlib}',str(source),'-o',str(binary)]
r=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True);(root/'lock-snapshot-build.log').write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
fixture=root/'lock-snapshot-fixture';fixture.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copyfile(root/'warm-shared-100/artifacts/ci-warm-cache/baseline/1/lpm.lock',fixture/'lpm.lock')
shutil.copyfile(repo/'bench/audit-fixtures/t3-install/package.json',fixture/'package.json')
rows=[]
for phase,rounds in [('warm',3),('scored',20)]:
 for i in range(rounds):
  for variant in (['baseline','candidate'] if i%2==0 else ['candidate','baseline']):
   result=subprocess.run([str(binary),variant,str(fixture),'25'],text=True,capture_output=True)
   assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr
   rows.append(dict(phase=phase,round=i+1,variant=variant,iterations=25,ns_per_operation=float(result.stdout.strip())))
artifact=dict(description='Isolated standalone post-install lockfile reads/serialization. Baseline performs three reads and two serializations; candidate performs one of each. Both verify identical content and path before timing. Same project path, three warm rounds, twenty scored alternating pairs, 25 operations per process. This isolates lockfile work; it does not model engine checks, hashing, linking, or install wall time.',build_command=cmd,source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),lockfile_sha256=hashlib.sha256((fixture/'lpm.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),rows=rows)
for variant in ['baseline','candidate']:
 values=[x['ns_per_operation']/1e6 for x in rows if x['variant']==variant and x['phase']=='scored'];print(variant,'median_ms',statistics.median(values),'range',min(values),max(values),flush=True)
(root/'lock-snapshot-micro.json').write_text(json.dumps(artifact,indent=2)+'\n')

run-cold-followups.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,shutil,time
root=Path('<scratch>')
repo=Path('<repo>')
base=['node','<parent-scratch>/readiness-retained.mjs','--managers','lpm,bun','--lpm-routes','direct','--lpm-firewall-modes','off','--lpm-binary','baseline='+str(root/'lpm-baseline'),'--lpm-binary','candidate='+str(root/'lpm-candidate-reuse'),'--allow-inconclusive']
status=[]
for fixture,mode in [('nest','cold'),('native-sharp','ci-cold')]:
 for phase,count in [('warm',1),('scored',24)]:
  assert shutil.disk_usage(root).free>=10*1024**3
  out=root/f'followup-{fixture}-{phase}'
  assert not out.exists()
  cmd=base+['--fixtures',fixture,'--modes',mode,'--samples',str(count),'--output',str(out)]
  print('starting',fixture,phase,flush=True);t=time.time()
  with (root/f'followup-{fixture}-{phase}.log').open('w') as f:rc=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=repo,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
  status.append(dict(fixture=fixture,phase=phase,exit_code=rc,seconds=time.time()-t,command=cmd));(root/'followups-status.json').write_text(json.dumps(status,indent=2))
  assert rc==0
  assert all(x['exit_code']==0 for x in json.loads((out/'rows.json').read_text()))
  print('finished',fixture,phase,flush=True)
